## The source

- URL of the actual data endpoint (not just the provider's homepage):
- Is it free, with no API key, or does it need self-service registration?
- **Terms of use**: link to the specific page/clause confirming automated/programmatic access for a
  use like this one is allowed. This is the step that matters most — this project has already
  declined several real, technically-reachable sources (CCIL, ACLED, OpenSanctions, SGX, Tadawul)
  specifically because their own terms forbade it. "I could fetch it" is not the same as "I'm
  allowed to."
- Update frequency / history depth.
